signOffConditionVerdicts.note: Every recorded role maps to at least one command class. A role authorising nothing is not a role in this set: a view-only operator is the absence of a role rather than a member of it.

All five command classes are covered. command by Remote Pilot and Maintenance Technician, parameter by Maintenance Technician, mission by Remote Pilot and Mission Planner, manual-control by Remote Pilot alone, payload by Remote Pilot and Payload Operator. So authorizeMavCommand() reaches a verdict for every class the station can emit rather than falling through.

guardPermissions.reason: With the role set and the authorization scope settled, a policy can be implemented and evaluated, so enforcement may become true.

Settling who may authorise a payload operation does not permit the station to actuate one. The payload controller owns actuation and payload safety, and a ground-station actuator path would be a second safety authority competing with it. This part permits no change regardless of what DG-PAY settles.
Same boundary. A role may authorise a payload operation an operator requests; nothing here permits the station to originate one by itself.

settled.element: for each role, the command classes the role may authorise
